text:
lucy: Postmortem follow-up: prioritize three things for rollout safety after yesterday's incident — tighten default canary caps, add a fast-acting circuit-breaker + auto-rollback, and a clear runbook with owners.
omar: Agreed. I'll scope the backend changes to enforce a hard max_canary cap at the router layer so console sliders can't exceed infra limits.
nick: I'll own the auto-rollback rules. Proposing: abort_on_errors=1% (rolling window 1m), abort_on_p95_increase=30% over baseline, and immediate quarantine for 5m before widening.
sophia: I'll add the alert queries and dashboard widgets. Need the exact metrics nick wants (error_count, p95delta).
ryan: For testing, I can add a synthetic canary job that runs in staging which varies sample_rate and injects latency/errors. Output should be a CSV we can feed to the runbook.
lucy: timeline: omar (router cap) PR by Tue 04/01, nick (auto-rollback) PR by Thu 04/03, sophia (dashboards & alerts) by Fri 04/04, ryan (sim harness + CI job) by Mon 04/07.
omar: Implementation note: router will reject requests that exceed hard_cap with 429 and flag audit logs. Config snippet: 
```
rollout_defaults:
  max_canary_percent: 1
  quarantine_timer: 5m
```
devops-bot: system: New task created: TASK-4581 (enforce max_canary_percent at ingress) assigned to omar.
nick: For auto-rollback we need a safe fallback model route. We'll implement multi-variant routing: primary->canary, fallback->stable. On abort we switch traffic back to stable and send a paged alert.
sophia: Do we want the console to show a live 'quarantine countdown' and allow manual override? Product asked for a hard cap + an override reason field.
lucy: hard cap is required. Manual override must be gated to SRE+owner and log reason. We'll add an approval flow in console later (out of scope for this sprint).
ryan: I'll add sim permutations: [sample_rate 0.1%, 0.5%, 1%], [error_rate 0.5%, 1%, 2%], [latency +50ms, +200ms]. Will output pass/fail by the auto-rollback rules.
omar: Also adding an infra-side kill-switch: if cluster-wide error_rate > 3% then auto-disable all non-critical flags.
nick: Can we standardize metric tags: flag.name, rollout.id, region, model.version so alerts map cleanly?
sophia: yes. I'll add those to tracing and the dashboard template.
lucy: Ops playbook items (ajustable): 1) How to triage when rollback triggers 2) Who to page 3) How to re-open a quarantined rollout 4) Post-rollback diagnostic checklist. Assign aj and dave for playbook edits.
devops-bot: reminder: oncall rota updated. Next dry-run scheduled for 04/06 10:00 PDT.
nick: Quick sample rule for the auto-rollback engine: 
```
if error_rate_60s > 0.01 or p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.3:
  trigger_rollback("auto", reason="safety_threshold")
```
ryan: note: tests need deterministic seeding for error injection so CI results are reproducible. I'll add that.
lucy: Great progress. Please post PR links here and tag when ready. We'll review in the eng-platform sync next Wed. :white_check_mark:
